dataset_rule: Clinic-first site audit. For every included clinic, procedures[] is NOT limited to Botox/Fillers/Rhinoplasty/Boob job/Hair transplant/Peels. It contains every numeric-priced treatment/service found on the public clinic website pages reviewed. A clinic is included only if at least one numeric public price was found.
limitations: A public-site audit cannot guarantee prices hidden behind login-only booking widgets, forms, private PDFs, phone quotes, or unindexed pages.
Public promotions and starting prices are preserved with price_type so the app can label them correctly.
Rows with no numeric public price are omitted rather than estimated.
